title: Introduce probationary burst admitter and decay-aware commitment allocator
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: tenants occasionally need brief bursts above their committed throughput but unbounded bursts cause downstream latency spikes and noisy eviction churn. This change introduces a probationary burst admitter that allows short, conditional burst windows for tenants who demonstrate sustained good behavior, paired with a decay-aware commitment allocator that reduces commit reservations gradually instead of instant decommit. The goal is to preserve tail latency SLOs while improving usable burst capacity and reducing oscillation during decommits.

Summary of changes: Adds a new admission controller (pkg/autoscaler/admitter.go) that maintains per-tenant probation windows, a scoring function (sustained_headroom_score) based on recent utilization, error rate, and request burstiness, and a token lease mechanism with fast-revocation path. Introduces decay-aware commitment allocator (pkg/autoscaler/commitment_decay.go) which applies an exponential decay to reserved capacity on scale-down events to avoid sudden supply cliffs. Exposes new policy fields in api/v1/burst_policy.proto and a config flag (autoscaler.probation_window_seconds) in helm charts.

Behavioral guarantees: Probationary bursts are time-limited and conditional: a tenant must keep a sustained_headroom_score above threshold for a configurable warmup period. If a tenant violates latency or error-rate objectives during probation, the admitter revokes burst tokens immediately and records a probation_failure metric which factors into the scoring for subsequent windows. The commitment allocator decays reservations by a configurable half-life, smoothing out capacity transitions and reducing eviction ripple.

Telemetry and observability: New metrics: autoscaler_probation_admit_rate, autoscaler_probation_failure_count, tenant_sustained_headroom_score (tagged by tenant_id, pool), commitment_decay_applied (sampled histogram). Traces: admission_decision and decay_transition spans added to runtime traces for root-cause and perf debugging. Updated Console dashboards (docs/ops/burst-admitter.md) with a probation window view and commit-decay heatmap.

API and config: api/v1/burst_policy.proto gains two optional fields: probation_enabled (bool) and probation_score_threshold (float). These are backward compatible (default to false/0.0). Helm values: autoscaler.probationWindowSeconds, autoscaler.commitmentDecayHalfLifeSec. CLI flag added to the autoscaler binary: --probation-mode={off,observe,enforce}.

Testing and performance: Unit tests (pkg/autoscaler/*_test.go) cover scoring, lease lifecycle, and decay math. Integration scenario in perf-canary simulates 500 tenants with mixed steady and bursty traffic. Results: median SLO breach rate reduced from 2.1% -> 1.6% on mixed workloads; 95th percentile tail latency improved by ~9% during dezonations due to softer decommits; usable burst throughput increased by ~12% for tenants that pass probation windows.

Rollout plan: feature gated behind autoscaler.probationMode=observe for an initial 2-week telemetry collection in staging, then enable enforce for a subset of pools (alpha pools) for 1 week before full rollout. Emergency kill-switch: autoscaler exposes /admin/probation/disable and operator can set helm flag to disable at runtime via configmap.

Backward compatibility and safety: Default config keeps probation disabled. Behavior is additive; existing reservation semantics preserved unless probation/enforce flags are enabled. No tenant-visible API changes unless bumping proto is applied to client config.

Open items and follow-ups: 1) Long-term we want an ML-derived headroom predictor to replace the simple score function (tracked in ENG-4603). 2) Add tenant-level alerting thresholds for probation_failure spikes (follow-up story).

Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-4521)  [x] unit tests  [x] integration test harness  [x] ops docs (docs/ops/burst-admitter.md)  [x] telemetry instrumentation  [x] helm values and defaults  [x] rollout plan

Files of interest and quick pointers are below. For reviewers: focus on admission correctness (revocation and safety), metric cardinality, and config surface area.

release_notes:
- Introduces probationary burst admission to allow short, conditional bursts for tenants with good sustained behavior.
- Adds decay-aware commitment allocator to smooth scale-down and reduce eviction churn.
- New telemetry metrics: autoscaler_probation_admit_rate, autoscaler_probation_failure_count, tenant_sustained_headroom_score.
- Ops docs and helm flags for staged rollout (autoscaler.probationWindowSeconds, autoscaler.commitmentDecayHalfLifeSec).
